facts.business: Thakkers Developers Limited is a real estate enterprise that executes construction projects through its subsidiaries.
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions during FY 2025-26 include advances paid (Rs 6030.01 crore), advances received (Rs 5102.39 crore), sale of fixed assets (Rs 290.00 crore), loans obtained (Rs 1326.30 crore), remuneration paid (Rs 58.50 crore), and salary paid (Rs 30.00 crore) with associates, wholly owned subsidiaries, directors' relatives, key management personnel, and enterprises where KMP have significant influence.
